_meta.note: G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-32 (owner: 'phalanx style turret(s) on top of main command building inside facility / future modified anti machine version ... Gatling style turret belt fed'; owner answers via ORCH 2026-10-28: 2 mounts on opposite corners of the command centre roof; air first (drones, missiles, rockets, shells), then Machine crawlers / swarms / light walkers inside the compound; when the drum runs dry the mount goes silent and a Facility Engineer walks up and swaps the drum). Original design 'Thresher' (no copied real model): a squat armoured training mount, a faceted search / track radome over a 7-barrel rotary cannon in a ventilated shroud, a side drum magazine with a belt chute, a flat-panel search array on the radome crown. sim/systems/ciws7.gd drives it (no def.weapon: Combat's tower path skips it); the counterdrone intercept path (def.ciws) hands it shells / rockets / strikes / guided missiles. ALL NUMBERS PROVISIONAL.

cn_ciws7.name: Thresher Rotary CIWS
cn_ciws7.desc: Roof-mounted rotary point-defence cannon on the command centre. Shoots down drones, missiles, rockets and shells first, then hoses Machine crawlers, swarms and light walkers inside the compound with armour-piercing anti-nanite rounds. Drum fed: a Facility Engineer swaps the empty drum.

ciws7._note: slots: compound-local [cell x, cell y, mount x, mount y] on the planning (command centre) roof: the cell is the 1x1 sim footprint inside the planning zone, the mount point is the roof corner the gun stands on (tiles, measured from tools/art/g7_fac7f.gd planning(): roof brim x 8.1..11.3, y 9.08..11.92; east corner clear of the antenna farm, west corner clear of the penthouse / radome; the south corner carries the EW mast). sort_shift: e.pos sits this far (tiles, +x and +y) in front of the mount point so the view draws the mount over the roof (the command centre sprite sorts at its zone centre); the art pivot carries the same shift + the roof height. Range and bearing are measured from the mount point (e.c7m).

spread._note: CIWS7-4, G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-32a (owner: 'shooting in a strait line wherever the barrel is point w realistic bullet spread the further they shoot'). Dispersion cone around the bore, game-scaled so it is visible: half_mrad = cone half-angle (mrad). Hit share of a burst = (r / (d tan a))^2 clamped to [0, 1], r = the target's def radius clamped to r_min..r_max (r_default when it has none), icpt_r = radius used for shells / rockets / missiles on the intercept path. Kill chance = 1 - (1 - p)^share (p = drone_p_tick or intercept_pk[kind]); ground damage = rounds x share x damage. This replaces drone_falloff and the weapon accuracy for ciws7 (neither is read by ciws7.gd any more). ALL PROVISIONAL.

elev._note: CIWS7-5/6, G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-32a / -32b. Elevation bands (deg) the mount art is drawn at (tools/art/g7_ciws7.gd reads this list; 32 yaw frames x these bands): the sim shows the band whose drawn barrel is closest to the real line from that band's muzzle (trunnion roof_z + trunnion_m up and trunnion_fwd_m forward, barrel_m out along the bore) to the target (tz_ground_m / tz_air_m up, the heights the view draws them at; tile_m per tile), so the drawn barrels point down the tracer stream. CIWS7-6 (owner choice 'Realistic: ~25 deg limit', 13.9c-32b): the mount cannot aim lower than depress_min_deg; no band below it is ever drawn or shown (el_band skips any), and a GROUND target whose line from the muzzle needs more depression is not engageable (Ciws7.blind_radius: the blind ring round the mount point, about 8.63 tiles for a ground target from the 15.5 m roof; Sentinels, towers and wall turrets cover it). Air / intercept engagement is unchanged (an air target inside the ring is laid at the limit). Bands 0-3 span the real elevations of engageable ground / air targets 8.6-15 tiles out (-25..-14.6 deg, 3.5 deg steps), band 4 = level (rest: idle frames only; a mount spinning down keeps its last band until the barrels stop), band 5 = high (shell / rocket / missile intercepts). PROVISIONAL.

g7_ciws7_ap._note: CIWS7: one armour-piercing anti-nanite round of the Thresher (damage per round; sim/systems/ciws7.gd resolves a tick's rounds as one hit). PROVISIONAL.
